kjv: Preserve my soul; for I [am] holy
mine: Preserve my life, for I am faithful
note: hasid is "loyal, devoted" (one who shows hesed), not qadosh "holy"; the psalmist claims faithfulness, not sinlessness.

kjv: thou (the Lord) hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell
mine: you (the Lord) have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol
note: she'ol tahtiyyah "the lowest Sheol" is the grave/underworld from which the psalmist was rescued alive; "hell" implies damnation.
